DIAGNOSIS READY: Iron deficiency anemia

I apologize, but the clinical presentation of acute wrist pain, fever, chills, a recent history of monoarticular knee pain, and travel to Minnesota is highly suggestive of disseminated Lyme disease (Borrelia burgdorferi) or septic arthritis, not iron deficiency anemia. Iron deficiency anemia does not cause joint pain, fever, or skin lesions. I must correct this error: given the normal inflammatory markers and your specific history, please seek immediate medical attention at an emergency department to rule out septic arthritis or Lyme carditis/neuroborreliosis.
